changelog: Added VehicleLife system: real mileage, owner & accident history, progressive wear, hidden faults, pre-purchase public report, and mechanic expertise.
Added SmartParking system: anti-false-positive world monitor, 3D no-parking zones, tow/police GPS dispatch tablet, and persistent RP impound actions.
Full live configuration for both systems via /conf_acn_realpark and automatic migration of existing vehicles.
